title: bufonia anatolica subsp. elatior
intro: Bufonia anatolica subsp. elatior, commonly known as Mountain Thyme, is a flowering plant species native to Turkey. The Mountain Thyme plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions are believed to include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Thyme include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
